verses.gurmukhi: ਅੰਬਰੁ ਨਦਰੀ ਆਂਵਦਾ ਕੇਵਡੁ ਵਡਾ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ।
verses.translit_en: a(n)bar nadharee aa(n)vadhaa kevadd vaddaa koi na jaanai|

en.bdb: The sky is seen but none knows its extent.

verses.gurmukhi: ਉਚਾ ਕੇਵਡੁ ਆਖੀਐ ਸੁੰਨ ਸਰੂਪ ਨ ਆਖਿ ਵਖਾਣੈ।
verses.translit_en: auchaa kevadd aakheeaai su(n)n saroop na aakh vakhaanai|

en.bdb: How much high it is in the form of vacuum is not known to anybody.

verses.gurmukhi: ਲੈਨਿ ਉਡਾਰੀ ਪੰਖਣੂ ਅਨਲ ਮਨਲ ਉਡਿ ਖਬਰਿ ਨ ਆਣੈ।
verses.translit_en: lain uddaaree pa(n)khanoo anal manal udd khabar na aanai|

en.bdb: Birds fly in it and even the anal bird which always remains flying does not know the mystery of sky.

verses.gurmukhi: ਓੜਿਕੁ ਮੂਲਿ ਨ ਲਭਈ ਸਭੇ ਹੋਇ ਫਿਰਨਿ ਹੈਰਾਣੈ।
verses.translit_en: oRik mool na labhiee sabhe hoi firan hairaanai|

en.bdb: Mystery of its origin is not known to any body and all are wonder-struck.

verses.gurmukhi: ਲਖ ਅਗਾਸ ਨ ਅਪੜਨਿ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਕਾਦਰੁ ਨੋ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੈ।
verses.translit_en: lakh agaas na apaRan kudharat kaadhar no kurabaanai|

en.bdb: I am a sacrifice unto His Nature; even millions of skies cannot express His grandeur.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਵਾਸਾ ਨਿਰਬਾਣੈ।
verses.translit_en: paarabraham satigur purakh saadhasa(n)gat vaasaa nirabaanai|

en.bdb: That true Lord resides in the holy congregation.
Only a devotee who becomes dead from the point of view of ego, can identify him.
